title: How can I delete the account?
content: Understand how to delete account on Marvelous Designer. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## ## **Details** #### #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1\. Visit “My Account” page from **[Marvelous Designer](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account)** to start the account deletion process. ![스크린샷 2025-05-21 오후 4.26.22.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438105606169) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "Account" tab. ![스크린샷 2025-05-21 오후 4.29.57.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438105832729) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![스크린샷 2025-05-21 오후 4.33.44.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438091987993) _💡**Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller_ _on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete_ _the account directly. Please click**"Contact US"** button for further assistance._ _*For enterprise user, end user id can ONLY be deleted on the license admin page_ ![mceclip3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438078459545) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. _**💡 Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active **only after the end date.**_ ![mceclip6.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438078688665) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ _💡**Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing._ ![mceclip7.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438107796889) 2\. Account will be deleted immediately after email verification and a short survey are completed. ![mceclip8.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438092801817) * * * **Important Notes on Account Deletion** 1) Once deleted, the account cannot be recovered, and sign-in will no longer be possible on both the website and software. 2) After deletion, content and posts previously created will display the user name as follows: * If the email address is shown: **“Deleted Account”** will be displayed instead. * If the account name is shown: it will remain as **{account name}** , as in the case of CLO-SET.

title: When I try to login, I get the following massage "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time"
content: This error message occurs when there is a failure between server connections. In case you are receiving this message while using the Marvelous Designer 8, then please first check if your network connection is stable or you have input wrong password or not. If you input the right login credential, you would be able to activate the license successfully with the onlineauth method. If you keep facing this issue however, please refer to the ([manual page](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358427341465)) for offline authentication method activation. For all the other versions with the same issue, please follow the instructions below for its solution. Also, please make our server address whitelist on your antivirus program. ![with.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097204377) * **With “Firewall Option” enabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. When you login, please check on the box saying “If using a Firewall, mark this checkbox”. 3. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 4. Please activate the license. ![without.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438112145689) * **With “Firewall Option” disabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 3. Please activate the license. **[How to open port 443 and whitelist Marvelous Designer’s server IP address.]** **1\. Open the control panel and go to 'Windows Defender Firewall' sections.** ![Xwaqc1aLWHzM0RKZWm5Phggk3suThFUkJYj8AIe7kiWJIdr1DvYVne9eXxunzy2oFpxgfCGTWT7OPnfYklNbMjQD1OZkb12QfrdXCgXTfNQg2ElNrH3XOkZgh0sxKfcA4Vq1Zto5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438162539801) **2 Go to 'Advanced settings' and click 'Inbound Rules'.** ![4dK68hcJOhqp7mRu0Ym7az9xExTFwR7xOm1065mQKOZaepfbn7xVpMjt3QrpwPni6VgAz0o9izAL9mXmMSkj4ed8izWStWhv-ydTtMO45nV5svqIprl4bK0cDmT2u3P45nhyoTVB.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097738905) **3\. On 'Action' menu, click 'New Rule'.** ![zTxrlfuGDX5qr_TWWaT4fssmuj3lCguT9KoHMrOFsdNrmAA3Gf6c_T05SbqupRo7-PO6V2WNSwNPF4IbcpN656bYALlITJ1OZlbkB_G7c08E62HLJURs9cOOjuKjGwZ078BQyl4Y.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098004761) **4\. Select 'Port' and click 'Next'.** ![JNVEfASi4Iquw6yPPEvNK3pG3yjuO_61SBCDjwaTJpIbI5Jlp1Mhmqugrt9AQHyMnm7EMuul04yu4XidQ7XmXjvcNHtGFvA1s7vidFOJhITMcjRuWvPKbyGFOUEDTJPLiSepBU8-.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098300441) **5\. Select 'TCP' and input '443' on the 'Specific local ports' section.** ![1gZV5mqSlg-TnT3TbECybl1oarVggQvu1TldW7TVY_PqVap4zsDpYfz1yRoelGvIpzWI754ksplWuGoM-ucNsxvw_cEAXEimq8qQOgSJTGfKuPsUu2RRZpsIarozrwRkfGZ4UtBD.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438145964441) **6\. Select 'Allow the connection' and click 'Next'.** ![KRcTmTLslRbRy1U_1WgfWS7KevQ7JGMG79Jw7QQZTIqLOgTQ73n7MqqQCSlravyldXSZVVzt_HPxBXWCN-3GnSp-64SJOMtsJQAN7QcWRzOUtPQJf7rkmocFxxOa1BYBlFBYbGeP.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438148995353) **7\. Input the rule name and click 'Finish'.** ![nOYjpKgChfk0KkSqsyWCrrFTfH8dszdhJdu7d3-BEFiNwpyNrujQnC69AxXjrD2r_IbNMBLpd9arzeJ0i-PXnHJYvUTwLouzyEU88eB5byQg7A_TW1ZBMgoAjLbyhl1p69HeDp3z.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438163877273) **9\. Open the 'Port 443's 'Properties'.** ![Wl0V_7FdzGp7eNbPpA-3VvsKXx0VA2Sq90G7GaGyKwytWKnj4met7xsPi3xanfDR1DFRU7xwoMdUglLrFnFxGWAyd6on8TKuV7CfrZ3lJUuCX9tEsc88jiC_Zi5wl2oWM4aYx74v.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438113652121) **10\. Go to the 'Scope' and select 'These IP addresses' on the 'Remote IP address' window, and click 'Add'.** ![MctTcujBgKVx0tipYoKY0DYDjheVSJk_CUCDu5k7wLEz2naSBm1qTmNCr8rZqv8x3TzNrGa_lzLYmQQVGJqcdz06kZEq41_1vx1pysv_RWFPa7NxRfUpKJWwBNrKycCLSeRHAzod.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438149915545) **11\. Input the following info on the 'This IP address or subnet' and click 'OK'.** ![c_3KC_I_mHFKs1h0IygAWZriUWzDwn4_iYG3tI379M0n7weixajkYIFZkQhNy5Uu_axnJ62jInfQvjzbqPuRimAz9mIzZBsKqgd2iqKx9X4xkFNlWGIotp9ERjxAQQ8ENatIiEUf.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438150128537) **In case you are still experiencing this issue after the guideline above, please refer to the instructions below.** **Step 1.** Open c:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\host file as a text file **Step 2.** Add # at the front for the lines that includes api.clo3d.com or sapi.clo3d.com After add # for the lines in the front, please try to login again.

title: Can I use Marvelous Designer for physical garment production?
content: Marvelous Designer is generally used in the video production or the game industries to create virtual garments and props, which means that Marvelous designer does not offer several functions that are essential in physical garment production. (e.g. to import/export DXF, to print out the paper patterns). If you are looking for a software to help you with proceeding the physical garment, we would like to introduce you to our sister software 'CLO 3D.' Visit [www.clo3d.com](http://www.clo3d.com) or contact us at [sales@clo3d.com](mailto:sales@clo3d.com)

title: Compatible File Format
content: ### Compatible File Format File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, also in a addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | .sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive overview of compatible file formats for importing and exporting 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, detailing the specifics of each format's capabilities and requirements.

title: What is the difference between Personal and Enterprise License?
content: There is a distinction based on the user's status. All users must comply with the "[Terms of Service](https://marvelousdesigner.com/terms)." Freelancers are allowed to use personal licenses, but all other companies (studios, game companies, research companies, etc.) must purchase enterprise licenses. If a corporate entity purchases personal licenses, access to the purchased Marvelous Designer license may be restricted or terminated without prior notice. If a personal license is purchased using a company's credit card or company email address, it may be considered as a purchase by a corporate customer.
content_description: This webpage outlines the licensing requirements and distinctions for users of Marvelous Designer, emphasizing the importance of compliance with the Terms of Service based on user status.

This revision was made to enhance accessibility to the benefits of learning Marvelous Designer, thereby allowing more students to enjoy the opportunity to learn and master this valuable software at their own pace. The revised policy provides students with an affordable pricing option and an extended duration of access, allowing ample time to explore and gain in-depth knowledge of the software. Our aim is to make it easier for students to access the benefits of Marvelous Designer, encouraging them to develop and master this valuable skill set. ## **[New Policy]** ## **License Option** * Student Yearly License: USD 99/Year (Not auto-renewal), up to 2 times within 4 years (since the first purchase) ## **Qualification** * University or college * A college or university that grants degrees after completing a regular course of study of at least two years (including 2-year public or private colleges and vocational schools) * Primary or secondary school * A licensed public or private primary, middle, or high school that provides regular education * Homeschool * Attendees of private CG-related courses * Certification of courses more than 3 months or curriculum schedule and tuition receipt is required _* Students will be asked to verify the student status through either school-issued email address or relevant documents on the purchase process._ _* If you have previously received a student discount, you can still benefit from the new student discount, which offers a 1-year license discount for two times. The eligibility criteria for the discount will remain the same during the checkout process._ ## **Methods of proving student qualifications** ## **Option 1. Use the email address issued by the school** If you enter your school email address, a verification email will be sent to that email address. Please verify your account through the verification email. ## **Option 2. Submit student verification documents** ## **[Institution of a student]** If you cannot verify through your school email address, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or grades should be removed before submission. The document must have been issued within the last six months. * Student ID card * Enrollment certificate or academic transcript * Proof of tuition payment or statement ## **[Homeschooling student]** If you are a homeschool student, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or amount should be removed before submission. * Copy of home school contract * Current membership ID of home school association * Proof of purchase of curriculum for current academy ## **[****Private CG-focused academic institution****]** If you are attending CG-related academic institutions, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. YouTube, private streaming broadcasts, and other informal online learning will not be qualified, and only official online or offline courses with existing curricula will be qualified. * Certificate of completion issued by formal institution * Course program schedule (at least 3 months) and tuition receipt ## **Notes** * Two-time purchase license (Not auto-renewed) * When you make your first purchase, your 'student status' will be activated. The 'student status' lasts for four years, and after that, you can purchase an additional license once. You will receive two benefits over a total of four years. * Once you have redeemed your student discount, you have the option to purchase a personal license. You can choose between monthly or yearly options for the personal license. * _**Refunds are not available under any circumstances. Please make your purchase carefully.**_ # **FAQ** Q. Where can I purchase a student license? You can purchase a student license on the pricing page by clicking on "[Buy Now](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)." Q. How do I verify my student eligibility? By clicking on the "[Get Started](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)" button for the student license, the school email verification process will begin. An authentication email will be sent through your school email, and you can proceed with authentication through the email. If you are unable to authenticate through your school email, please proceed with authentication through "Manual Input" or "Document Submission." Q. What payment methods are accepted? You can make payments using credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal. The payment method is a prepayment for a one-year license. Q. Can I cancel my student license subscription midway? You cannot cancel your subscription midway, as it is a prepayment for a one-year license. Please choose carefully when making your purchase. Q. Can I keep my existing subscription for the student license? If you are currently subscribed to the previous version of the student license, you can keep your existing subscription. You can also take advantage of the benefits of the updated student license after your current subscription has expired. Q. Can I cancel my current subscription and purchase a new student license? If you have a current subscription, you cannot purchase a new student license before the expiration date of your current subscription. You can check the expiration date on the [license page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license). You can purchase a new student license after the expiration date, but you will need to go through the student authentication process again. Q. How long is the validity period for the second discounted offer after purchasing a student license with the first discount offer? The validity period for the second discounted offer is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Please check your student authentication validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section. Q. If I did not use the second discounted offer within the four-year validity period of the student authentication, can I receive the student discount again for a new purchase? If you did not use all the discounted offers within the validity period of the student authentication, you cannot receive additional discounts. Please check the validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section and make sure to purchase within the validity period. Q. Does student license benefit also expire when the discount benefit expires? The four-year validity period only applies at the time of purchase. If you have purchased a student license prior to the expiration date, you may still use the license even after the expiration date has passed. For instance, if you purchase a license after applying the first discount offer on November 1, 2023, you may purchase the license with a second discounted offer until October 30, 2027, which is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Moreover, the license can be used until October 30, 2028.
